remarks: SPECTACULAR LAKE ONTARIO "FRANK LLOYD WRIGHT" INSPIRED DREAM ESTATE.....A STUNNING DESIGN BLENDS WITH NATURE! THIS WATERFRONT NATURE PARADISE FEATURES 210' LAKE-LEVEL STONE BEACH WITH APPROXIMATELY FIVE ACRES AND IS ADJACENT TO THE PROTECTED WATERS OF BALD EAGLE CREEK TO DOCK YOUR BOAT WITH ACCESS TO LAKE ONTARIO! ULTIMATE PANORAMIC MILLION-DOLLAR LAKE ONTARIO VIEWS! THIS IS THE ULTIMATE IN LAKE LIVING WITH A BEAUTIFUL OPEN LIVING INTERIOR.....STARTING WITH A SPACIOUS FOYER WITH CUSTOM WOODWORK AND TILE FLOORS. OPEN TO THE HALLMARK OF THIS SPECIAL HOME, A SPACIOUS GREAT ROOM FEATURING A WALL OF WINDOWS AND THOSE BREATHTAKING LAKE VIEWS, HEARTHSTONE WOOD STOVE & HARDWOOD FLOORS, WITH A DREAM COOK'S KITCHEN WITH CUSTOM CABINETRY, STAINLESS STEEL APPLIANCES, QUARTZ COUNTERTOPS & MORE! ALL WITH ACCESS TO AN ENTERTAINMENT-SIZED PAVER PATIO WITH MILLION-DOLLAR LAKE VIEWS! THE LANDSCAPING IS JUST BEAUTIFUL, FEATURING A POND WITH WATER LILIES! PLUS A LAKE VIEW PERGOLA WITH A PATIO AND THOSE AMAZING SUNSETS! THE 1ST FLOOR FEATURES A SPACIOUS PRIMARY SUITE WITH BATH, PLUS A POWDER ROOM & LAUNDRY. THE EXCITEMENT CONTINUES UPSTAIRS WITH A CUSTOM WOOD STAIRCASE AND A VERY SPACIOUS PRIMARY SUITE FEATURING A WALK-IN CLOSET, BATH, AND STUNNING ELEVATED LAKE VIEWS! PLUS ANOTHER BEDROOM & OFFICE OR 4TH BEDROOM & BATH! THE QUALITY CRAFTSMANSHIP IS EVIDENT IN THE DETAILS, BOTH INTERIOR AND EXTERIOR! COMPLETELY REBUILT IN 2004! THE PROPERTY ALSO INCLUDES AN OUTBUILDING LARGE ENOUGH TO STORE MANY BOATS. THE SWEEPING LAWN HAS MANY BEAUTIFUL FLOWERS & PLANTS AND FEATURES A SPECIAL ANTIQUE SAILBOAT MAST FOR THE FLAGS! IN ADDITION, THIS RARE PROPERTY IS THE ULTIMATE IN PRIVACY AT THE END OF BALD EAGLE DRIVE. NEARBY ARE BALD EAGLE MARINA AND HAMLIN BEACH STATE PARK, WITH EASY ACCESS TO ROCHESTER, BUFFALO, AND THE WESTERN NEW YORK REGION.....MAKING THIS A VERY SPECIAL PROPERTY! ALL AT AN AMAZING VALUE!
